Property description

This small industrial unit enjoys shared access to it and is located to the rear of residential dwellings and neighbours a churchyard. The property is being sold with a 15 year lease in place commencing in 2023 and expires in 2038 with 5 yearly rent reviews. It is our opinion that the site offers long-term development potential subject to gaining the necessary consents. The land extends to 0.07acres / 0.03hectares.

Location

The property occupies a convenient position in Edgware, within the London Borough of Barnet, close to Edgware High Street and its extensive range of retail, leisure and banking facilities. Edgware Underground Station (Northern Line) is within walking distance, providing direct access to Central London. The area also benefits from excellent road communications via the A5, A41, M1 (Junction 4) and the M25.
